metadata.short_desc: Play SillyTavern remotely through your bot
metadata.desc: Operates and interacts with SillyTavern via the Playwright headless browser, letting you play SillyTavern remotely through a bot for a richer experience than shared-session scripts.

language.hint: Language of the plugin's chat replies and page backend messages; independent from the WebUI display language

now_chats_name.hint: Stores and displays the current character card; do not edit it here

browser_ip.hint: Remote address and protocol used to connect to the tavern

browser_port.hint: Remote port used to connect to the tavern

browser_delay.hint: Delay between clicks and lookups, in milliseconds

upload_interval.hint: Seconds allowed for sending a character card after /酒加卡

reaction_emoji.hint: QQ emoji reaction attached to the triggering message while a command runs, replacing a text placeholder. Use a QQ system emoji ID (e.g. 319 = heart) or an emoji character (e.g. 🫶); leave empty to disable. QQ only; requires the protocol to support set_msg_emoji_like

show_floor_count.hint: When enabled, /酒 replies are prefixed with "X floors total"; off by default. Does not affect /酒查看

global_persona_binding.hint: When enabled, persona bindings apply globally per QQ account (same persona in all groups); when disabled, bindings are isolated per group. Off by default

browser_Visible.hint: Turn off to make the browser visible for debugging and inspecting load state

admin_only.hint: When enabled, all tavern commands require an admin; toggle live in chat with /酒权限 管理 开|关

whitelist_groups.hint: Group IDs allowed to use tavern commands; empty means no restriction. Maintain with /酒权限 白名单 群号

blacklist_groups.hint: Group IDs forbidden from using tavern commands; takes priority over the whitelist. Maintain with /酒权限 黑名单 群号

low_memory_mode.hint: When enabled, the browser is opened temporarily for each command and closed afterwards (slower, no resident memory). When disabled, the browser stays resident for fast responses. Both modes prevent leftover browser processes; if issues persist, use /酒进程 to clean up

lines:
/酒 [text]
Sends your input to the tavern and returns the result. Images are not supported; empty input is not allowed

/酒切换 [name]
Switches the character card. Does nothing if the name is not in the list; numbers are not allowed

/酒删除 [count]
Deletes floors. Defaults to one floor when no count is given; deleting two floors including your own input is recommended

/酒加卡 [image] or /酒加卡
Adds a character card to the tavern. Supports attaching the image directly, replying to a message with an image, or sending the image alone within the time limit

/酒删卡 [name]
Deletes the named character card. If it is the current card, switches to the default; the default card cannot be deleted

/酒重生成
Regenerates the latest floor's input and returns it. Takes no arguments

/酒续写
Continues the latest floor, letting the AI keep generating after its latest reply

/酒备选 [上|下]
Switches to the previous/next alternative reply of the latest floor; defaults to next (next regenerates)

/酒停止生成
Stops the generation currently in progress

/酒新建
Starts a new chat with the current character (clears the floors)

/酒导出
Exports the current chat history as a JSONL file and sends it

/酒统计
Shows chat stats for the current character (messages/words/generation time, etc.)

/酒改名 [old] [new]
Renames a character card; the default character name cannot be changed

/酒查看
Shows the latest floor's messages, including your own input if it is latest. Reply to a message first to locate its floor number

/酒人设
Shows your bound persona and the tavern persona list

/酒人设 绑定 [name]
Binds a tavern User Persona for you; /酒 and /酒重生成 will switch to it first

/酒人设 查看 [name]
Shows details of a persona (name, description, position); without arguments shows the persona list

/酒人设 修改 [name] [content]
Creates or modifies a persona: creates if absent (empty persona with name only), updates the description if present with content, deletes if present without content

/酒人设 解绑
Unbinds your current persona

/酒世界书
Lists all world info books and the currently active ones

/酒世界书 查看 [name]
Shows entries of a world info book (trigger keywords and content)

/酒世界书 切换 [name]
Toggles a world info book on/off for the current character

/酒开始 群聊
Enables tavern chat mode: messages are forwarded to the tavern directly without the /酒 prefix. With "群聊" it applies to the current group, without it to you only

/酒结束
Ends the tavern chat mode you created

/酒状态
Shows the current character card, the character list, and the browser status

/酒帮助
You are literally reading it right now.

/酒启动[admin]
Starts the tavern in the plugin directory and auto-connects

/酒重置[admin]
Resets all global variables; try this when variables are in a broken state

/酒关闭[admin]
Closes the plugin browser and cleans up all background chrome/chromium processes

/酒权限[admin]
Manages command access: 管理 开|关 (admin mode), 白名单 [群号|移除 群号], 黑名单 [群号|移除 群号]

/酒进程[admin]
Shows the current chrome/chromium process count and browser status
